description: Replying to @Jazzy preparation is cultivating and nourishing whats existing and being flexible! #careeradvice #lifebydesign #careershift #IntentionalLiving
transcript: I focused closely on preparation when I knew that I was ready to leave that role. I took four months to put some systems into place. One thing that I put into place is really cultivating my network. My network is absolutely invaluable. I have C-suite level execs, founders, etc. All around my network that I can call for any and everything and vice versa. Secondly, I am beyond flexible. I am not married to any industry or any job title. I do not put red tape around what I will and won't do. Because when I do that, I miss out on opportunities. So I allow my value and my skills to leave me.
